8.5+ years of strong experience in design, architecture, orchestration & implementation of a number of successful scalable projects from the ground up in industries like Healthcare, Insurance, Natural resources & Mining & Collaborative tools and platforms.

=== AREA OF EXPERTISE ===
Team building & Leadership, Risk management & mitigation, Release management, Source control management, Agile development & continuous integration, Proactive Communication (Written & Verbal), Java & J2EE, Data Structure & Algorithm, Product Design, Development, Verification & Delivery

=== PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE ===
- April 2013 – Nov 2015: 2 years 8 months, Senior Lead – Software Development, Exeter Software India Pvt. Ltd., Bangalore
- July 2007 – Mar 2013: 5 years 9 months, Staff Software Engineer, IBM – India Software Labs, Bangalore

=== KEY LEADERSHIP HIGHLIGHTS ===

Technology Leadership:
- Leading & concluding 5+ go-live scenarios
- SPOC for 60% product functionality
- 3rd party API Integration leading to business opportunities
- Adopting configurable product feature model
- Leading 24x7 troubleshooting for 1 year
- Productizing 3+ client-critical solutions
- Coding an encryption layer for reduced security risks
- Crossing over tech comfort zone to design and develop product features across product layers
- Winning many innovation hackday contests

Process Leadership:

Youngest member of IBM's Technical Expert Council & Youngest member of Prototyping & Architecture group of Exeter. Reducing page load time from 150s to under 3s. Adopting configuration driven feature development & deployment.

Technical contributions:
- 60% technical & functional ownership of product features
- 3x faster page loads by adopting a memoized data-fetch model

- 2x faster implementation via re-architecting & creating central modules

- Reduced security risks by coding an encryption layer in Java
- Reusable code-base via designing & delivering centralized business layer
- Creating wireframes to depict improved customer UI interaction
- Technology abstraction by evangelizing single-portlet model
- Successfully leading & resolving 15+ customer critical situations in 20 months
- Creating logical domain models, OOAD, assisting dev team to navigate through technical difficulties

Leadership contributions:
- SPOC for functionalities between Legal, Functional, Dev & QA teams
- 5+ release scoping, execution, artefact & configuration management
- Data driven post release analysis to identify shortcomings & mitigation
- Implementing code-review & artefacts benchmarking standards
- Leading 5+ successful execution of go-live troubleshooting sessions
- Implementing project level knowledge share sessions to reduce SPOF
- Devising a Dev to QA to Deployment hand-off process
- Regular performance reviews, mentoring & career planning for 15+ members
- Established command-control protocol to achieve a 24-hour churn cycle
- Driving 24x7 product support continuity for 1 year
- Org level hack-days, giveback programs, training sessions, cultural events

=== STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER, IBM – ISL, BANGALORE (JULY 2007 – MARCH 2013) ===
Technical contributions:
- Enabling JAXWS on IBM's LWI framework via SOAP 1.2
- Practising TDD for Lotus Expeditor Webcontainer
- Achieving virtual-zero defects for Expeditor toolkit releases
- Developing data-transformation layer for NRCOE solutions
- Innovation through work – 2 USPTO filed patents
- 1 ip.com publication, 3 developerworks articles
- Regular Scrum Master, with task planning & execution ownership

Leadership contributions:
- SPOC for Lotus Expeditor Webcontainer
- On-boarding team members from iterative to agile development model
- Leading customer presentations & demonstration of solutions
- Evangelizing peer product adoptions at org level
- Organizing Technical Leadership exchanges & Hackdays
- Presenting Lotus Expeditor in open-source Eclipse launch sessions

- Patent: Managing key performance indicators, published on April 2nd 2015. Patent Citations: 2
- Patent: Determining and conveying user availability, published on October 15th 2013. Patent Citations: 27. Non-Patent Citations: 8

- TRMS Spot Award for contributing towards team process improvements, Nov 2017

- Amazon recognised facilitator for Scrum & Agile Product Ownership Workshops
- Mentored a final year CSE graduate from NIE Mysore via the Mentor Together program

- Authoring knowledge share articles on developerworks community for LotusLive, LotusLive Engage & Smartcloud Meetings
- Delivering knowledge share sessions on adopting-agile-like-practices, design patterns
- Conducted a year-long Tech/Fun sessions via the TExeter program
- Conducted 1-day hands on session at CSI Bangalore chapter on design patterns, 19th April 2015
- CSI BC Board Committee Member & conducted technology related workshops & seminar sessions across Karnataka
- Invited to Gujarat, Marwadi Engineering College, to conduct hands-on Advanced Java & J2EE workshop, 21st Sept 2013
